$comment: Generated by schemas/generate.py from architecture baseline 1.4 Ch11/12/16. Authority domains have independent exact discriminators. Unknown properties fail closed. S0 supports no requiredFeatures and provides no boot, signature, image, or execution proof.

BackendOptions.$comment: Ch13 names Dinit smooth-recovery. This optional closed extension requires service.backend.dinit/v1; S0 rejects that required feature rather than pretending to execute it.

BootPolicy.$comment: Ch11 names BootPolicy without a layout. This implementation uses the declarative subset of Ch12 BootRecord: publisher, root, unlock, cmdline, health and conditional UKI recipe. Built artifact metadata appears only in BootRecord.

BootRoot.$comment: Filesystem enum is a syntactic S0 vocabulary, not recovery qualification for any driver. S0 does not boot.

Cmdline.$comment: Ordered kernel tokens. Semantic checks require exactly one misa.root=kind=value token (Ch12 H2), no misa.generation= token, and rendered byte length below kernel.cmdlineLimit including the appended generation token.

Desktop.$comment: Ch15 desktop metadata concretized for declarative ExportSpec; this is not the runtime ExportRecord or resolved ExecSpec.

icons.$comment: Set-like array: semantic validation additionally requires ascending ASCII key order and unique identity keys.

mime.$comment: Set-like array: semantic validation additionally requires ascending ASCII key order and unique identity keys.

ExportSpec.$comment: Ch11 ExportSpec concretization: id is the plan-local key; name is a host CLI name; root is an OCI manifest digest. grants references hostGrants IDs. Full-host v1 has no hostGrants and therefore requires empty grants. argv is ordered and never shell-expanded.

Features.$comment: Set-like array: semantic validation additionally requires ascending ASCII key order and unique identity keys.

ForeignStorage.$comment: leased-gc has a complete wire form but S0 semantic validation rejects it with E_CAPABILITY: no qualified broker.

gates.$comment: Set-like array: semantic validation additionally requires ascending ASCII key order and unique identity keys.

Ids.$comment: Set-like array: semantic validation additionally requires ascending ASCII key order and unique identity keys.

KeyRef.$comment: Ch16 KeyRef concretization: non-secret Ed25519 public key, canonical padded RFC4648 base64 of exactly 32 bytes; S0 does not verify signatures.

MountFlags.$comment: Set-like array: semantic validation additionally requires ascending ASCII key order and unique identity keys.

OwnedMount.$comment: Ch11 concretization: owner is hostId or a declared service/provider ID. Both paths are host paths. Exclusive writable ownership uses component boundaries, never string-prefix matching.

Path.$comment: Canonical absolute UTF-8 lexical path. Symlink, mount and object-identity checks are outside S0. No Unicode normalization.

ProviderBinding.$comment: Ch11 concretization: each exact versioned capability has one exclusive provider; requirements resolve to provided capabilities. Provider id is also a service-graph node ID.

provides.$comment: Set-like array: semantic validation additionally requires ascending ASCII key order and unique identity keys.

PublisherKey.$comment: Validity values are UTC Unix seconds. Ch16 publisher key IDs resolve through the root-owned key registry, not embedded private material. Semantic validation checks windows and rotation references.

RootSelector.$comment: Ch11 RootId and Ch12 selector concretization: lowercase persistent UUIDs, not /dev names or unauthenticated labels.

ServiceGraph.$comment: Ch11 graph concretization: targets maps milestone IDs to member service IDs; nodes and all references are plan-local. requires and after participate in cycle checks; wants alone does not order.

services.$comment: Set-like array: semantic validation additionally requires ascending ASCII key order and unique identity keys.

ServiceSpec.$comment: Ch4 and Ch13 concretization. Scope is tagged, timeout/window/delay/gracePeriod units are seconds, env values are tagged literals or secret references. A milestone has no process fields. No runtime backend implementation is asserted by accepting a schema.

directories.$comment: Set-like array: semantic validation additionally requires ascending ASCII key order and unique identity keys.

sockets.$comment: Set-like array: semantic validation additionally requires ascending ASCII key order and unique identity keys.

StoreFile.$comment: A store output or descendant; lexical syntax is not a closure or artifact verification.

StoreOrOCIRef.$comment: Ch11 tagged reference concretization: OCI layout plus manifest digest, or Nix store object holding an OCI layout; never a materialized-tree identity.

TrustPolicy.$comment: Ch16 proposed policy layout, closed. Threshold roles are concretized as root/targets/snapshot/timestamp; interactive approval has zero cryptographic threshold and no keys. Policy consistency is validated, not authenticity, freshness, enrollment, or approval.

No derived UKI digest, ESP path, publication sequence or signing secret enters the generation body.
